thread:
monica: FYI escalation from AcmeCorp — multiple customers hitting 5xx + timeouts when calling /v1/generate via hosted API since ~09:10 UTC. Customer reports SDK retry loop and increased token billing. They provided sample request and logs. Marking P2 for now, but customer is seeing production impact.

ben: ack — can you paste the minimal repro (curl) and any request IDs they sent?

monica: pasted below. customer-request-id: acme-req-20260315-87. repro curl (they used our python sdk but this curl reproduces):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-medium-1","input":"summarize: very long prompt...","max_tokens":512}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response they saw: intermittent 502/503/504. example headers:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Tue, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:33 GMT
Server: redwood-gateway/2.8
x-request-id: acme-req-20260315-87
content-type: application/json
content-length: 142
```
Body was short: `{ "error": "upstream timeout" }`

clara: thanks. pinging runtime/edge. deploy-bot shows a canary deploy to gateway service at 09:05 UTC (sha: f1a2b3). linking.

deploy-bot: deploy gateway-service f1a2b3 to prod-canary at 2026-03-15T09:05:12Z :rocket:

ben: I ran the curl from our us-west host against the same model and saw the same 503s with identical x-request-id header. Captured tcpdump around the request — looks like TLS handshake + then connection reset from upstream after ~7s.

tara: upload logs? any 5xx spikes on infra dashboards?

ben: uploaded tail from edge-proxy (trimmed):
```
[09:11:47] proxy: routing request id=acme-req-20260315-87 -> runtime-pool-02
[09:11:55] proxy: upstream timeout id=acme-req-20260315-87 after 8.0s
[09:11:55] proxy: returning 503 to client id=acme-req-20260315-87
[09:11:55] runtime: instance-07 closed connection prematurely id=acme-req-20260315-87
```

clara: runtime full logs show instance-07 OOM-kill-like messages around that time? grabbing container logs.

ben: also note repeated retries from customer SDK — their pattern: immediate retry x3 with no exponential backoff, which likely amplified load. they attached their SDK config (default retries=3).

monica: customer says SDK is official python client v1.2.0 — they thought retries were safe. they want us to confirm if this is server-side or client causing billing.

clara: preliminary root cause hypothesis: a combination of a recent canary change to kernel selection + a rare memory regression in runtime container caused intermittent instance crashes under heavier concurrency. Edge proxy sees upstream connection resets and returns 503/502. SDK naive retries caused a feedback loop, amplifying requests and causing more instances to crash — also explains billing spike.

tara: can we reproduce with a small harness? i'll run a parallel 50-concurrency loop with a long prompt to stress KV cache.

ben: running now from staging sim: `wrk -t8 -c50 -d30s --latency https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -s ./scripts/long_prompt.lua`

ben: reproducer produces ~15% 5xx within 30s, logs show instance restart traces and full gomaxprocs memory footprints.

clara: confirming container logs show `runtime: out of memory: kill process 1234 (redwood-runtime)` and then kube restarts. kernel change in canary may have increased mem usage for certain attention kernels.

monica: customer-facing status? they asked for ETA.

tara: immediate mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing at gateway to older runtime variant (v2026-03-10) for affected models; 2) temporarily increase instance pool size; 3) ask customers to enable SDK circuit breaker and backoff. I'll open a rollout revert PR for the canary.

clara: I can push a hotfix to runtime to avoid the memory regression, but takes ~2-3 hours to build/test and roll. revert of gateway kernel selection is faster if we can route traffic to previous runtime image.

ben: I've already added a routing override in the gateway to send AcmeCorp traffic + a sampled 10% of traffic back to stable runtime. monitoring shows 503s for AcmeCorp dropped to ~2% after the override.

monica: sweet — drafting a customer update. Please confirm we have a recommended SDK config snippet to reduce retry amplification.

tara: suggested SDK guidance (python):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=\"X\", timeout=30, max_retries=2, backoff_strategy={\"type\":\"exponential\",\"base\":0.5,\"max\":10}, circuit_breaker={\"fail_threshold\":5,\"reset_timeout\":60})
```
Add note: set idempotency_key for non-idempotent generation to avoid duplicate billing when retrying.

monica: customer message draft: "Thanks — we've identified a runtime regression introduced in a recent canary that can cause intermittent upstream timeouts. We've routed your traffic to a stable runtime and are rolling a hotfix. Please set your client to use exponential backoff and a short circuit breaker while we complete the fix. We'll follow up with timeline in ~2 hours." Anyone edit?

clara: fine w/ me. add that we will credit any obvious duplicate billing from the retry loop after investigation.

ben: ops note: also enabling a temporary global limit of 5 concurrent in-flight requests per API key at gateway to reduce amplification while hotfix rolls. config change applied.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-42 — "Persistent 5xx for hosted generate; routing override applied; hotfix in progress" assigned to eng-runtime.

monica: customer updated and acknowledged — they reduced client concurrency immediately and saw improvement. They asked for a timeline to hotfix. estimate from eng-runtime?

clara: hotfix build + canary deploy in ~2 hours, full rollout after 30m successful canary. I'll post updates in this thread.

tara: followups: (1) confirm exact SDK versions affected in docs; (2) publish short KB article on "what to do if you see 5xx and retry loops"; (3) prepare billing review for duplicates.

monica: noted. I'll own customer comms and billing followup. tagging support playbook. :thumbsup:

ben: monitoring now — dashboards show tail-end recovery. Will keep 10m check-ins.

clara: pushing hotfix branch now. linking PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/879

monica: thanks team. please update thread with any change to ETA. closing loop with AcmeCorp when fix rolls. :pray:
